key.name: toggle-popup
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the clipboard popup

key.name: auto-paste
key.summary: Paste immediately after choosing an entry
key.description: When off, choosing an entry only puts it on the clipboard.

key.name: terminal-aware-paste
key.description: Only used when auto-paste is on. Terminals are recognised by their window class or app id.

key.name: default-search-mode
key.summary: Search mode the popup opens in (Tab toggles)

key.name: result-limit
key.summary: Maximum entries shown in the popup
